title: Lapulapu
summary: Lapulapu was the chief of Mactan Island whose soldiers wounded Ferdinand Magellan in an encounter on 27 April 1521, according to a 1941 Philippine historical marker. A foundation account calls him Rajah Lapulapu and notes that the story of the battle rests mostly on the chronicler Antonio Pigafetta, as no account from his warriors' side survives.

uncertainty.note: Only the year of the battle at Mactan is attested; birth and death dates are not given on the opened pages.

importance.justification: Chief associated with the 1521 battle in which Magellan died; a national symbol of resistance in the Philippines.
